fields.label: App Guide
fields.options:
ExpertEdge App — User Guide

ExpertEdge manages the full student lifecycle for the CMA Australia & New Zealand program: from lead intake through qualification, counselling, payment collection, CMA registration, and enrollment.

1. How the Flow Works

  1. Lead arrives — via web form, ad webhook, or manual entry → creates an EE Lead
  2. Telecaller contacts — logs calls in the Call Log table, sends brochure, requests documents
  3. Documents verified — counsellor verifies uploaded documents
  4. Counselling session — counsellor creates an EE Counselling Session, sets outcome
  5. Confirmed — if outcome is “Fit – Confirmed”, lead status auto-moves to Confirmed
  6. Convert to Student — click the button on a Confirmed lead → creates an EE Student with all data copied
  7. Pre-Approval Payment — generate a payment link (AED 200), mark paid when received
  8. CMA Registration — register student with CMA ANZ, mark as registered
  9. Balance Payment — generate balance link, mark paid
  10. Enrollment & Materials — mark enrolled, issue materials, send welcome email

2. Roles & What Each Role Can Do

RoleAccess
EE TelecallerCreate & manage Leads. Log calls. Send brochure & doc request emails. Read-only on Students & Sessions.
EE Academic CounsellorVerify documents on Leads. Create & manage Counselling Sessions. Edit Student CMA section & batch. Read billing (can’t edit).
EE FinanceEdit Student billing fields. Create & manage Payment Links. Mark payments as paid. Read Leads.
EE ManagerFull access to everything. Manage settings, programs, batches, roles.

3. Key DocTypes

DocTypePurposeWhere to Find
EE ProgramThe qualification (e.g. CMA ANZ). Defines fee, currency, discount.Setup card in workspace
EE BatchA scheduled cohort (country, venue, dates, capacity). Students enroll into a Batch.Setup card
EE LeadProspective candidate. High-volume — only ~1% convert. Lightweight by design.Lead Management card
EE Counselling SessionRecords a counselling call/meeting and its outcome.Lead Management card
EE StudentConverted candidate. Billing, CMA registration, enrollment all live here.Student Management card
EE Nomod Payment LinkPayment link (stub for now). Tracks amount, status, and creates Payment Entry on payment.Student Management card
EE Lead SourceMaster list of where leads come from (Instagram, Facebook, etc.)Setup card
EE Document TypeMaster list of required documents (Resume, Degree, Transcript, etc.)Setup card

4. Step-by-Step: Processing a Lead

4a. New Lead

  • Lead auto-created from web form / webhook, or manually via New Lead shortcut
  • Status starts at New
  • A ToDo is created for the assigned telecaller with SLA timer
  • Mandatory document rows (Resume, Degree, Transcript) are pre-seeded

4b. Contact & Qualify

  • Add rows to the Call Log table for each call attempt
  • First call auto-stamps first_contacted_on and moves status to Contacted
  • Click Actions → Send Brochure to email the brochure → status moves to Brochure Sent
  • Click Actions → Request Documents → status moves to Docs Requested

4c. Verify Documents

  • As documents arrive, tick Received and upload the file in each document row
  • Counsellor ticks Verified on each row
  • Click Actions → Mark Documents Verified → all rows must be received+verified → status moves to Docs Verified

4d. Counselling

  • Create a new EE Counselling Session linked to the lead
  • After the session, set the Outcome field
  • If outcome = Fit – Confirmed: lead auto-moves to Confirmed and a ToDo is created to convert

4e. Convert to Student

  • On a Confirmed lead, click the Convert to Student button (blue primary button)
  • Creates an EE Student record with all data, documents, call log, and activity log copied
  • Lead status → Converted (locked, cannot be converted again)

5. Step-by-Step: Processing a Student

5a. Pre-Approval Payment (AED 200)

  • Click Billing → Generate Pre-Approval Link
  • This auto-creates the Customer + Sales Invoice if not done yet
  • Share the payment link with the student
  • When paid, open the Payment Link and click Actions → Mark as Paid
  • A Payment Entry is auto-created and student status moves to Pre-Approval Paid

5b. CMA Registration

  • Register the student on the CMA ANZ portal
  • Enter the CMA Candidate ID
  • Click Actions → Mark CMA Registered → status moves to CMA Registered

5c. Balance Payment

  • Click Billing → Generate Balance Link → creates a link for the outstanding amount
  • Tick Apply Lump-sum Discount before generating if student pays in full (saves 5%)
  • Mark as Paid when received → student auto-moves to Fully Paid when outstanding = 0

5d. Enrollment & Materials

  • Manager marks status as Enrolled
  • Click Actions → Issue Materials → status moves to Materials Issued
  • Click Email → Send Welcome Email with venue, timing, and Day-1 checklist

6. Emails

Six email templates are pre-configured. Each is triggered by a button:

ButtonTemplateWhen to Use
Send Brochure (Lead)EE - Brochure & IntroductionAfter first contact
Request Documents (Lead)EE - Document RequestAfter brochure sent
Send Pre-Approval Email (Student)EE - Pre-Approval PaymentAfter conversion, with payment link
Send Receipt (Student)EE - Payment ReceiptAfter any payment received
Send Balance Email (Student)EE - Balance PaymentAfter CMA registration
Send Welcome Email (Student)EE - Welcome & Programme DetailsAfter enrollment
Tip: You can edit the email template content at /app/email-template. Templates use {{ doc.field }} Jinja syntax to pull data from the Lead/Student record.

7. Reports

ReportWhat It Shows
Conversion FunnelCount per lead status + overall conversion rate
Telecaller PerformanceCalls made, connection rate, leads handled, SLA compliance, conversions per telecaller
Call ActivityRaw call log — every call across leads & students, filterable by date and result
Counsellor PerformanceSessions done, Fit-Confirmed %, resulting enrollments per counsellor
Payment CollectionPer student: net fee, paid, outstanding, days since start

8. Settings (This Page)

  • Defaults — Company, program, batch, billing currency, accounts, service item
  • Nomod — Payment gateway config (leave blank for now — stub mode)
  • Email Templates — Link each button to its email template
  • Brochure — Upload the PDF brochure to attach with the brochure email
  • SLA Timers — Hourly checks create ToDos when deadlines are breached

9. Lead Intake Channels

  • Web Form — Public form at /program-enquiry. Share this URL on your website.
  • Ad Webhook — Point Meta/LinkedIn lead-ad webhooks to /api/method/expertedge.api.lead_webhook.webhook
  • Manual / Bulk — Use Data Import with the sample CSV format in the app
De-duplication: If a lead with the same email or mobile already exists (and isn’t Lost/Converted), the system adds a note to the existing lead instead of creating a duplicate.

10. SLA Monitoring

The system checks every hour and creates ToDos for:

  • Leads not contacted within {first_contact_sla_minutes} minutes
  • Documents not received within {doc_turnaround_sla_hours} hours of request
  • Pre-approval payment not received within {post_counselling_payment_sla_hours} hours
  • Balance payment not received within {full_payment_sla_days} days

11. Programs & Batches

  • EE Program = the qualification (CMA ANZ). Defines the canonical fee (AED 3,500), discount %, and pre-approval amount.
  • EE Batch = a scheduled cohort for a specific country/city. Has venue, dates, timing, capacity. Can override the program fee if needed.
  • Students are enrolled into a Batch. The batch’s venue/timing feeds the welcome email.

12. Quick Reference: Status Flow

Lead Statuses

New → Contacted → Brochure Sent → Docs Requested → Docs Received → Docs Verified → Counselling Scheduled → Counselling Done → Confirmed → Converted | Lost

Student Statuses

Pre-Approval Pending → Pre-Approval Paid → CMA Registration → CMA Registered → Balance Pending → Fully Paid → Enrolled → Materials Issued | Dropped
